name: google-keyword-planner-mcp
description: Keyword ideas, search volumes, CPC ranges, trends and forecasts from Google Ads Keyword Planner.
long_description: Research keywords with Google Ads Keyword Planner data from any MCP client. Generate ideas from seed keywords, a URL or a whole site; get monthly search volumes, competition and top-of-page bid ranges for exact keywords; forecast clicks and cost; and look up location and language IDs. Locations and languages accept plain names like "Nigeria" and "English". Requires a Google Ads account, a developer token with Basic access, and an OAuth client.

tools.name: generate_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Keyword ideas from seed keywords, a URL or a site, with volumes, competition, bids and trends.

tools.name: get_search_volume
tools.description: Historical search volume and metrics for specific keywords.

tools.name: forecast_keywords
tools.description: Forecast impressions, clicks and cost for keywords at a max CPC.

tools.description: Find Google location IDs by name.

tools.name: list_languages

developer_token.title: Developer token
developer_token.description: From the API Center in your Google Ads manager account. Needs Basic access for real data.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
